resolvedFinding.observation: Replacing the Map alone left obsolete failure entries reachable through in-flight readSource captures. The current snapshot count was bounded but total old-epoch retention could exceed160.
resolvedFinding.resolution: Root added failedSources.clear() before assigning the new Map in pin(). This releases obsolete entries immediately while preserving Map identity as the epoch guard.
